title: Power Automate: Cloud flows - View property value expanded inline in new cloud flow designer
description:
When you add an action, you can view property values for multiple steps at design time, or output values for multiple steps at runtime. The inline view shows this information directly on the cards, so you can review and compare values across several steps at once.

Without the inline view, you select each card individually to see its value in the side pane, and you can view only one step's value at a time. This makes it harder to compare values across steps.

You can choose which experience you prefer. The current side pane experience remains the default. You can switch to the inline view whenever you want and switch back at any time.

Business Value:

You can be more efficient when authoring or debugging flows by using the inline view to examine property values from multiple steps at once without needing to select each step separately.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically
